findings.title: Unfair risk allocation for site preparation
findings.message: The short text "Baustelleneinrichtung" and long text "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" lack specification of responsibilities for site security, waste removal, and site maintenance. According to VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1, the description must be unambiguous and exhaustive. The clause "Das gesamte Baugrundrisiko trägt der AN" in the project remarks further shifts all ground‑related risks to the contractor, which may be considered an unfair risk transfer under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the contractor is responsible only for site preparation up to the point of handover, and that the owner bears the ground risk beyond that point. Include a clause limiting liability for ground conditions.

findings.title: Missing technical details for excavation
findings.message: The long text "Boden gemäß Baugrubenprofil lösen und ausheben" does not specify the homogeneity class, depth, or side‑storage requirements. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires the specification of the homogeneity area (e.g., DIN 18300) and the depth of excavation. Without these, the contractor cannot determine the correct method and may incur additional costs.
findings.suggestion: Add "Boden gemäß Baugrubenprofil, Homogenbereich [B1] gemäß Geotechnischem Bericht vom [Datum], Aushubtiefe bis [3,00] m, Boden seitlich lagern."

findings.title: Unspecified disposal site for waste material
findings.message: The long text states "Nicht wiederverwendbares Bodenmaterial zur zugelassenen Deponie transportieren" but does not name the specific depository or confirm its compliance with local regulations. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires the specification of the disposal site and its approval status.
findings.suggestion: Include the name and address of the approved disposal site and reference the relevant approval document.

findings.title: Missing specification of frost protection material
findings.message: The long text "Frostschutzmaterial liefern und nach Vorgabe einbauen" lacks the material type, class, and installation depth. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for frost protection. Without them, the contractor may use an unsuitable material, leading to future defects.
findings.suggestion: Specify "Frostschutzmaterial XPS, d = 100 mm, WLS 035, druckbelastbar [CS(10/Y) 300]".

findings.title: Missing connection details for PE-HD pipe
findings.message: The long text mentions "Verbindungsteilen" but does not specify the type (e.g., compression, solvent cement) or the required pressure class. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for pipe installations.

findings.title: Missing concrete class for shaft construction
findings.message: The long text states "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen herstellen" but does not specify the concrete class or reinforcement details. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these specifications.
findings.suggestion: Add "Betonfertigteile aus C25/30, mit Bewehrung gemäß DIN 1045".

findings.title: Missing concrete mix details
findings.message: The long text references DIN EN 206 and DIN 1045 but does not specify the concrete mix design, slump, or curing regime. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for concrete work.
findings.suggestion: Add "Beton C25/30, Mischverhältnis 1:2:4, Schüttung 5–10 cm, Nachbehandlung 28 Tage".

findings.title: Missing masonry class and reinforcement details
findings.message: The long text "Kalksandsteinmauerwerk nach statischer Vorgabe herstellen" does not specify the masonry class, mortar type, or reinforcement. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for masonry work.
findings.suggestion: Add "Mauerwerk KS 17,5 cm, Mörtel M 3,5, mit Bewehrung gemäß DIN 1045".

findings.title: Missing plaster finish details
findings.message: The long text "Innenputz als einlagigen Putz fachgerecht herstellen" lacks the plaster type, thickness, and curing conditions. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.

findings.title: Missing details for cement screed
findings.message: The long text "Zementestrich einschließlich Randdämmstreifen herstellen" does not specify the screed thickness, mix design, or reinforcement. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.
findings.suggestion: Add "Zementestrich CT-C25-F4, 20 mm, mit Bewehrung 10 mm, Randdämmstreifen 30 mm".

findings.title: Missing thermal conductivity and thickness for floor insulation
findings.message: The long text "Wärmedämmplatten liefern und vollflächig verlegen" lacks the insulation thickness, thermal conductivity, and class. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for insulation work.
findings.suggestion: Add "Wärmedämmplatten XPS, d = 100 mm, WLS 035, druckbelastbar [CS(10/Y) 300]".

findings.title: Missing water exposure class for waterproofing
findings.message: The long text "Abdichtung gemäß geltenden technischen Regeln herstellen" does not specify the water exposure class, material, or thickness. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details for waterproofing of earth‑contacting elements.
findings.suggestion: Add "Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile mit PMBC, Wassereinwirkungsklasse W1.2-E, Trockenschichtdicke 3 mm, einschließlich Hohlkehle".

findings.title: Missing concrete slab details for paving
findings.message: The long text "Betonpflaster liefern, verlegen und verfugen" lacks the slab thickness, reinforcement, and curing regime. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.
findings.suggestion: Add "Betonpflaster 150 mm, mit Bewehrung 10 mm, Nachbehandlung 28 Tage".

findings.title: Missing asphalt mix details for base layer
findings.message: The long text "Asphalttragschicht liefern, einbauen und verdichten" does not specify the mix design, compaction level, or thickness. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.

findings.title: Missing asphalt mix details for wearing layer
findings.message: The long text "Asphaltdeckschicht herstellen und verdichten" lacks the mix design, compaction level, and thickness. VOB/C § 4.2.1 requires these details.
